summary.text: Ben Hansen is a member of the Nebraska Legislature (Unicameral) representing District 16, serving since 2018 (elected 2018, re-elected 2022). His committee assignments are Agriculture, Business and Labor, and Health and Human Services.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Hansen was born June 29, 1979, in Schuyler and graduated from Schuyler Central High School in 1998.
He earned a B.S. in psychology from Wayne State College in 2002 and a D.C. from Palmer College of Chiropractic in 2007.
His biography lists his occupation as chiropractor, and past service on the Blair City Council from 2015 to 2018 and on the Blair Chamber of Commerce board from 2012 to 2018.
It lists him as married to Jill Christine Groene since July 13, 2002, with one child.
